Transaction in Own Shares Computacenter PLC 29 October 2024 Computacenter plc Incorporated in England Registration number: 03110569 LEI: 549300XSXUZ1I19DB105 ISIN: GB00BV9FP302 Computacenter plc Transaction in own shares Computacenter plc (the Company ) announces that on 29 October 2024 it purchased through J.P. Morgan Securities plc 170,000 Computacenter plc ordinary shares of 7 5 / 9 pence each, at a volume weighted average price paid (per ordinary share) of 2326.2549 pence, pursuant to its Share Buy-back Programme, the details of which were announced on 26 July 2024. Computacenter plc Transaction details: Computacenter plc ordinary shares of 7 5 / 9 pence each Issuer Name: Computacenter plc ISIN Number: GB00BV9FP302 Intermediary Name: J.P. Morgan Securities plc Intermediary Code: JPMSGB2LXXX Time Zone: BST Currency: GBP Aggregated Information: London Stock Exchange BATS Number of ordinary shares purchased 113,000 57,000 Highest price paid (pence per ordinary share) 2340.0000 2340.0000 Lowest price paid (pence per ordinary share) 2316.0000 2310.0000 Volume weighted average price paid (pence per ordinary share) 2326.3551 2326.0563 The Company intends to hold the purchased shares in treasury. Following the above transaction, the Company holds 11,424,033 of its ordinary shares in treasury and has 106,263,937 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). Since 26 July 2024, Computacenter plc has purchased 7,877,172 ordinary shares.
